description: This file contains the implementation of the DefaultDistributedDataConfig class, which provides configuration settings for distributed data, including timeouts and Akka replicator configuration, within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: DefaultDistributedDataConfig
classes.description: Implements the DistributedDataConfig interface, managing read/write timeouts and Akka replicator configuration for distributed data.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultDistributedDataConfig based on provided Config, with fallback settings.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultDistributedDataConfig with specified replicator name and role.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code based on configuration fields.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the config object.
